### Frontend Files

## How **Accept** Works

**Frontend (`Lead-bucket.tsx`, `handleAccept`)**:
1. If lead is `AVAILABLE` → calls `claimPartnerLead(token, lead.id)` (POST `/partner/leads/:id/claim`), then immediately `updatePartnerLeadStatus(token, lead.id, { status: "ACCEPTED" })` (PATCH `/partner/leads/:id/status`). Two sequential calls.
2. If lead is `CLAIMED` and `lead.partnerId === currentPartnerId` → calls only `updatePartnerLeadStatus(..., "ACCEPTED")`.
3. Any other status → shows a toast error, no call made.

After success, the lead id is added to `revealedLeadIds`, which unmasks seller name, phone, and pickup schedule (previously shown as `"XXXXX"`).

**Backend (`/leads/:leadId/claim`)**: Sets `partnerId` on the lead, transitions status to `CLAIMED`, appends disposition event + outbox event.

**Backend (`PATCH /leads/:leadId/status`)**: `isAllowedTransition` enforces:
- `CLAIMED → ACCEPTED` ✓
- `ACCEPTED → IN_PROGRESS | REJECTED | CANCELLED`
- `IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED | REJECTED | CANCELLED`
- `AVAILABLE → *` is **not allowed** here (claim endpoint must be called first)

The `COMPLETED` transition additionally requires `onsiteValidation.result === "PASS"` **and** `paymentProof` to be present.

---

## How **View Details** is Linked/Enabled

In the list table, "View Details" is always rendered as a `<Link>` — it is **never disabled** regardless of status:

```tsx
<Link to="/Lead-bucket-details" search={{ leadId: row.id }} className="lead-view-btn ...">
  View Details
</Link>
```

On the details page (`Lead-bucket-details.tsx`), the **Accept Lead** button is enabled only when `lead.status === "AVAILABLE" || lead.status === "CLAIMED"` (computed in `acceptEnabled`). The details page re-fetches the individual lead via `GET /partner/leads/:leadId`.

---

## Status Transitions (full matrix)

| From | To (allowed) |
|---|---|
| `AVAILABLE` | `CLAIMED` (via `/claim`) |
| `CLAIMED` | `ACCEPTED` |
| `ACCEPTED` | `IN_PROGRESS`, `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED` |
| `IN_PROGRESS` | `COMPLETED`*, `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED` |

*`COMPLETED` requires `onsiteValidation.result === "PASS"` + `paymentProof` present.

Setting `IN_PROGRESS` also calls `setPartnerLeadPickupStartedAt` to stamp `pickupStartedAt`.

---

## Payment / Coin Checks

**No coin deduction on claim or accept.** The coin system (`partner_coin_wallets`, `/coins/balance`, `/coins/recharge`) exists but is **completely separate** from the lead accept/claim flow — there is zero coin balance check or deduction in `POST /claim` or `PATCH /status`. Payment proof (`paymentProof`, `paymentProofJson`) is only a prerequisite to mark a lead `COMPLETED`, not to Accept it.

- Quote `300-10000` → `500 Pay to Unlock lead`
- Quote `10001-24999` → `800 Pay to Unlock lead`

**Backend Steps**
1. Add a quote-to-unlock-price helper:

   - Mirror existing `creditPartnerCoins`
   - Insert `partner_coin_ledger` row with `txn_type = "DEBIT"`

Here is the complete picture of how a partner lead/deal is closed today:

---

## Deal Lifecycle: Close/Completion Flow

### Status machine (`isAllowedTransition` in [backend/src/domains/partner/partner.routes.js](backend/src/domains/partner/partner.routes.js#L137))
```
AVAILABLE → CLAIMED → ACCEPTED → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED
                                              ↘ REJECTED | CANCELLED
```

---

### Key Identifiers

| Field | Table/Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `partner_leads.id` | TEXT PK | The deal/lead UUID — used in every API call |
| `partner_leads.user_sell_flow_id` | TEXT UNIQUE FK | Ties lead back to the originating user sell flow (1-to-1) |
| `partner_leads.partner_id` | TEXT FK | The partner who owns/accepted the lead |
| `partner_leads.user_id` | TEXT FK | The seller |

Both `lead.id` and `lead.userSellFlowId` travel on every outbox event and disposition event — use `lead.id` as the canonical reference for a coin debit.

---

### Backend Endpoints (all under `/api/v1/partner/leads/:leadId`)

| Method | Path | Function | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/claim` | `claimPartnerLead` | AVAILABLE → CLAIMED |
| `PATCH` | `/status` | `updatePartnerLeadWorkflowStatus` | CLAIMED→ACCEPTED, ACCEPTED→IN_PROGRESS, IN_PROGRESS→COMPLETED |
| `PATCH` | `/call-status` | `markPartnerLeadCallStatus` | Log call attempt |
| `POST` | `/onsite-validation` | `savePartnerLeadOnsiteValidation` | Save `{ result, checklist, observedIssues, revisedQuote, notes, photoAssets }` into `onsite_validation_json` |
| `POST` | `/payment-proof/metadata` | `savePartnerLeadPaymentProofMetadata` | Save `{ id, amountCollected, paymentMode, transactionRef, mediaUrl }` into `payment_proof_json` |
| `POST` | `/completion` | `savePartnerLeadCompletionEvent` + `updatePartnerLeadWorkflowStatus` | Save `completionCode, handoverChecklist, finalAmount, remarks` then flip to COMPLETED |

**`PATCH /status → COMPLETED` has two hard guards** (line ~430 in routes):
- `existing.onsiteValidation.result === "PASS"` must be true
- `existing.paymentProof` must be non-null

**`POST /completion` has the same two guards** and is the preferred terminal call.

---

### Onsite Validation Schema ([partner.routes.js](backend/src/domains/partner/partner.routes.js#L77))
```js
{ result: "PASS"|"FAIL"|"NEEDS_REWORK", checklist: {}, observedIssues: [], revisedQuote?: number, notes?: string }
// stored as onsite_validation_json; column: partner_leads.onsite_validation_json
```

### Payment Proof Schema ([partner.routes.js](backend/src/domains/partner/partner.routes.js#L85))
```js
{ id: uuid, amountCollected: number, paymentMode: "UPI"|"BANK_TRANSFER"|"CASH"|"OTHER",
  transactionRef?: string, notes?: string, mediaAssetId, mediaUrl, submittedAt }
// stored as payment_proof_json; column: partner_leads.payment_proof_json
```

### Completion Schema ([partner.routes.js](backend/src/domains/partner/partner.routes.js#L97))
```js
{ completionCode?: string, handoverChecklist: {}, finalAmount: number, remarks?: string }
// stored as completion_event_json; column: partner_leads.completion_event_at
```

---

### Frontend Details Page

[frontend/src/routes/Lead-bucket-details.tsx](frontend/src/routes/Lead-bucket-details.tsx) — `LeadBucketDetailsPage()`:
- Calls `getPartnerLead(token, leadId)` on mount
- Reads `lead.status` to label the Accept button (no completion/onsite actions exist in this UI yet — those APIs are in `gadgetpe-client.ts` but not wired to any page)
- `handleAccept()` calls `claimPartnerLead` then `updatePartnerLeadStatus(…, { status: "ACCEPTED" })`

Frontend API functions in [frontend/src/lib/api/gadgetpe-client.ts](frontend/src/lib/api/gadgetpe-client.ts):
- `claimPartnerLead(token, leadId)` — line 1089
- `updatePartnerLeadStatus(token, leadId, { status, reason? })` — line 1100
- `submitPartnerOnsiteValidation(token, leadId, { result, checklist, observedIssues, revisedQuote, notes, photos })` — line 1168

- `completePartnerLead(token, leadId, { completionCode, handoverChecklist, finalAmount, remarks })` — line ~1240

---

### Coin Debit Mapping (what to reuse)

For mapping a coin debit to a lead unlock:

- **Lead key**: `partner_leads.id` (UUID) — use as `reference` in `partner_coin_ledger` (e.g. `"lead-unlock:{leadId}:{partnerId}"`)
- **Wallet primitive**: `creditPartnerCoins` in [backend/src/db/repository.js](backend/src/db/repository.js#L3246) — mirror its SQLite transaction pattern for a `debitPartnerCoins` that inserts `txn_type = 'DEBIT'` and decrements `partner_coin_wallets.balance`
- **`partner_coin_ledger` columns available for debit**: `id`, `partner_id`, `txn_type`, `amount`, `method`, `reference`, `note`, `metadata_json`, `created_at`
- **No unique constraint** exists on `(partner_id, reference)` in `partner_coin_ledger` today — duplicate protection must be code-level inside the same transaction

I refined the plan like this:

## Added Design: Lead Unlock Order

Create a new backend table like `partner_lead_unlocks`.

Each paid unlock gets one record:

- `id` — unlock order id
- `lead_id` — maps to `partner_leads.id`
- `partner_id` — who paid
- `user_sell_flow_id` — maps back to seller quote/order journey
- `unlock_price` — `500`, `800`, or `1200`
- `ledger_entry_id` — exact coin debit row
- `status` — `UNLOCKED` / `CLOSED` / maybe `REFUNDED` later
- `created_at`
- `closed_at`
- `metadata_json`

## Important Behavior

When partner clicks `Pay to Unlock lead`:

1. Backend creates unlock order
2. Wallet coins are debited
3. Ledger row is created as `DEBIT`
4. Ledger is mapped to that unlock order and lead
5. Lead is assigned to partner
6. Lead status becomes `ACCEPTED`
7. Details become visible

When that deal is closed/completed:

1. Lead becomes `COMPLETED`
2. Matching unlock order becomes `CLOSED`
3. No second debit happens
4. No global wallet reset happens
5. That particular lead/order has `remainingCharge = 0` because the unlock coins were already consumed

The key detail: we should **not make the partner’s whole wallet 0** after closing one deal. That would accidentally remove coins meant for other leads. Instead, the unlock order for that specific lead becomes closed/consumed, with no reusable balance attached to it.

## Mapping

Use:

- `partner_leads.id` as the main deal/lead id
- `partner_lead_unlocks.id` as the unlock/order id
- `partner_coin_ledger.reference = lead-unlock:{leadId}:{partnerId}`
- `partner_coin_ledger.metadata_json` containing `{ unlockOrderId, leadId, partnerId, userSellFlowId }`

This gives complete traceability:

Recharge → Wallet Credit → Lead Unlock Debit → Unlock Order → Lead Accepted → Deal Closed

Yes, this changes the flow from **wallet debit immediately** to **QR payment intent + admin approval**. That is better for your requirement.

I updated the saved plan in `/memories/session/plan.md`.

**New Flow**
1. Partner clicks `Unlock Lead`
2. Backend creates a **Payment Intent / Lead Order Mapping**
3. Partner is redirected to `/Lead-bucket/Unlock-payment`
4. Page shows `Leadpay.jpeg` QR from [frontend/public/Leadpay.jpeg](frontend/public/Leadpay.jpeg)
5. A 4-minute countdown starts
6. After 4 minutes, QR becomes masked/hidden
7. Button below QR: `Send Screenshot to admin`
8. Button opens:

```text
https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=919311125745&text&type=phone
```

9. Same click also marks the intent as `SCREENSHOT_SENT` in backend
10. Page shows `Waiting for admin approval`
11. Admin sees this under `Payment Intent to Leads Mapping`
12. Admin approves
13. Only then:
    - Lead gets assigned to partner
    - Lead status becomes `ACCEPTED`
    - Seller/phone/pickup details reveal
    - `View Details` becomes active

**Backend Design**
Use `partner_lead_unlocks` as the payment intent/order table.

Statuses:

```text
PENDING_PAYMENT
SCREENSHOT_SENT
APPROVED
REJECTED
EXPIRED
CLOSED
```

Important columns:

```text
id
lead_id
partner_id
user_sell_flow_id
unlock_price
payment_method
status
screenshot_status
admin_note
approved_by
approved_at
rejected_at
created_at
expires_at
closed_at
metadata_json
```

**New Partner APIs**
```text
POST /api/v1/partner/leads/:leadId/unlock-intent
```

Creates the intent and locks that lead to the partner in pending state. This happens immediately on `Unlock Lead` click, so admin can already see it.

```text
GET /api/v1/partner/lead-unlock-intents/:intentId
```

Payment page polls this to know if admin approved.

```text
POST /api/v1/partner/lead-unlock-intents/:intentId/screenshot-sent
```

Called when partner clicks WhatsApp button.

**New Admin APIs**
```text
GET /api/v1/partner/lead-unlock-intents/admin
PATCH /api/v1/partner/lead-unlock-intents/:intentId/verify
```

Admin verifies with:

```ts
{ action: "APPROVE" | "REJECT", note?: string }
```

**Admin UI**
Add a new admin section named:

```text
Payment Intent to Leads Mapping
```

Columns:

```text
Intent ID
Lead ID
Partner ID
Quote Price
Unlock Price
Status
Created At
Expires At
Screenshot Sent
Action
```

Approve button here is what actually unlocks the lead.

**Frontend Routes**
New route:

```text
/Lead-bucket/Unlock-payment
```

Suggested file:

```text
frontend/src/routes/Lead-bucket.Unlock-payment.tsx
```

It should:
- read `intentId` and `leadId` from search params
- use existing partner token from localStorage, so no OTP login again
- display `/Leadpay.jpeg`
- show 4-minute timer
- mask QR after expiry
- open WhatsApp on screenshot button
- mark screenshot as sent
- poll for admin approval
- redirect back to Lead Bucket or Details after approval

**Important Change From Previous Implementation**
The previous implementation debited wallet coins immediately. For this QR/admin approval flow, unlock should **not assign the lead immediately**. It should only create a pending payment intent.

Actual lead assignment happens only when admin approves.

This gives the exact lifecycle:

```text
Unlock Lead click
→ Payment intent created
→ QR payment page
→ WhatsApp screenshot sent
→ Admin sees Payment Intent to Leads Mapping
→ Admin approves
→ Lead assigned + View Details enabled
→ Deal completed
→ Unlock order marked CLOSED
```
